# A pin the advisory database has entries for. The scan has to refuse this file.
#
# Nothing installs it and nothing in this project depends on it. It is here so
# that the failure path of the scan is exercised rather than assumed: a scanner
# that had stopped reading the database would report no vulnerabilities over the
# real lockfiles and look exactly like one that was working.
#
# Its neighbour under ../neighbour/ is the same file at the fixed version and
# has to pass, without which refusing every input would satisfy this half.
jinja2==2.11.2
